audience: video teams and developers who render marketing and product videos with Shotstack

useCases.title: Render a video from a JSON timeline
useCases.text: Send a timeline and an output setting to render a video. Then check the render until its status is done or failed. Production renders use credits.

useCases.title: Save a timeline as a reusable template
useCases.text: Save a timeline and output as a named template. Render it later for each video with its own merge fields.

useCases.title: Update a saved template
useCases.text: Read a saved template by id, then replace its timeline and output. The whole template is replaced, so send the full timeline.

useCases.title: Check a media file before editing
useCases.text: Inspect a public video, audio or image file by its URL. Read its duration, size, codecs and frame rate before you add it to a timeline.

useCases.title: Quote an AI generation before you start it
useCases.text: List the AI video, image, voice and music models. Quote one generation first, because the quote does not charge or generate the asset.
